metadata.name: ring-persistence
metadata.selection: minimum frozen validation-v1 balanced error; no final-evaluation selection

config.notes: All targets are known training targets. One training initialization per regime is a case study, not replicated training. Thresholds fixed before training. Moderate or severe classification uses actual occupied cells removed.

memory_measurement: Process-lifetime ru_maxrss; includes preceding evaluations in this process.
recovery_time_convention: Elapsed steps at confirmation of first 3 consecutive acceptable post-damage samples; retained_recovery separately records later deterioration.
